title: ShadeDrops Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Daily Mineral Milk Sunscreen

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, mineral, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Mineral SPF✓ FSA/HSA Eligible✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A lightweight, broad spectrum mineral sunscreen that protects skin from UVA/UVB rays with SPF 50 while delivering soothing hydration.
Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Zinc Oxide and Titanium Dioxide: These all-natural sun filters shield skin from damaging UVA/UVB rays.
- Antioxidant Complex: Vitamin E, vitamin C and ectoin prevent visible signs of aging.
- Ceramide NP + Glycerin: Hydrate and support the skin barrier, leaving skin soft and smooth.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: For weightless, skincare-infused sun protection.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well before use.
-Apply evenly over skin as the final step in your skincare routine and before makeup. Use the two-finger rule—squeeze a line of sunscreen down the length of your index finger and another line down your middle finger.
-Apply all over the face, neck and ears, ensuring all areas are covered.
-Reapply every two hours.
Ingredients+
-Zinc Oxide and Titanium Dioxide: These all-natural sun filters shield skin from damaging UVA/UVB rays.
-Antioxidant Complex: Vitamin E, vitamin C and rctoin prevent visible signs of aging.
-Ceramide NP and Glycerin: Hydrate and support the skin barrier, leaving skin soft and smooth.

Zinc Oxide 5.93%, Titanium Dioxide 5.46%, Water/Aqua/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Butyloctyl Salicylate,Propanediol, Coconut Alkanes, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter,Alumina, Polyglyceryl-10 Diisostearate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexyl Methoxycrylene, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Stearic Acid, Silica, Distarch Phosphate, Caramel, Succinoglycan, Tocopherol, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate,
Diethylhexyl Syringylidenemalonate, Glycerin, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, 1,2-Hexanediol, Benzyl Alcohol, Ectoin, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Allantoin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Matricaria Chamomilla (German Chamomile) Flower Extract, Xanthan Gum, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Ceramide NP.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
